sentences.text: In Mainz-Bingen, 593 reports over ten years show a main time from February to October, with the highest numbers in June and August.
It has been recorded eating Bull Thistle, Garden cosmos, Borage, and common dandelion.
Asian hornet, Goldenrod Crab Spider, and Shiny crab-spider are recorded as predators.
It has also been recorded visiting the flowers of Phacelia.
